systems.system: Mpox surveillance application integrated with DHIS2
systems.platform: Flutter/Vue.js mobile and web application linked to DHIS2 by REST API
systems.owner: local developer with the South Kivu Provincial Health Division
systems.tiers: pilot in three health zones (Uvira, Fizi, Walungu), South Kivu
community relays in the pilot zones
health facilities transmit data to it, often late or incomplete, as stated

note: A surveillance pilot for epidemic case notification, posted 22 April 2026; the national DHIS2 is named as available but what it reports is not described, and no level of data entry or facility count is given.
